The '''Autoscan Weapons Detector''' was a stationary [[weapon detector]] produced by the [[Corellian Security Force]]. They were commonly found in [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]] and secure installations across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a large device placed near public thoroughfares. When deployed, the Autoscan Weapons Detector tracked individuals and vehicles and scanned them for weapons. Upon the detection of any weapons, the detector alerted security personnel.
